component.name: Translocator
component.summary: Dual-pane file manager with SSH, S3 and WebDAV locations

description.p: Translocator is a classic dual-pane file manager: two folders side by side, everything from the keyboard, copies and moves queued in the background with per-item conflict resolution.

Either pane can show a local disk, an SSH server, an S3 account or a WebDAV share. The SSH location runs ordinary shell commands over one multiplexed OpenSSH connection, with your own ssh setup and nothing installed on the server, so copies between two folders on one server never travel through this machine, and sudo works as in a terminal.

ul.li: Type to filter a list, mark with Space, saved folders per host
Compare and synchronize folders, rename many files from masks
Open archives as folders, compress and extract
View and edit files, including those on a server
A quick preview in place of the other pane
Ten colour schemes, each with a light and a dark variant
